tropical_outlook: No threat. NHC reported no tropical cyclones in the Atlantic as of Nov 16 (1815 UTC discussion), and local coverage dated Nov 17 says NHC expects no tropical cyclone formation in the Atlantic, Caribbean or Gulf over the next 7 days. Rain in Florida this week is from a non-tropical low near the Bahamas, and no Week 11 game is played in Florida. Season ends Nov 30.

No snow or high-wind event is indicated at any venue.
